ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.manage.update

Updates the Cross Currency curve definition with the definition provided.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.manage.update.

update(
    curve_definition: CurveUpdateDefinition,
    segments: Segments,
    *,
    overrides: OptOverrides = None,
    turns: OptTurns = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    session: Session = None,
) -> Response

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
curve_definition CurveUpdateDefinition Yes CrossCurrencyCurveUpdateDefinition object.
segments Segments Yes list of CrossCurrencyInstrumentsSegment objects
overrides OptOverrides No None OverrideBidAsk object.
turns OptTurns No None
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
session Session No None session=None - means default session would be used

Returns

Response

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves import definitions
response = definitions.manage.update(
    curve_definition=definitions.CrossCurrencyCurveUpdateDefinition(
        id="7bdb00f3-0a48-40be-ace2-6d3cfd0e8e59",
        source="SourceName",
        name="rename curve",
        base_currency="EUR",
        base_index_name="ESTR",
        quoted_currency="USD",
        quoted_index_name="SOFR",
        is_non_deliverable=False
    ),
    segments=[
        definitions.CrossCurrencyInstrumentsSegment(
            start_date="2021-01-01",
            constituents=definitions.CrossCurrencyConstituentsDescription(
                fx_forwards=[
                    definitions.FxForwardInstrumentDescription(
                        instrument_definition=definitions.FxForwardInstrumentDefinition(
                            instrument_code="EUR1M=",
                            tenor="1M",
                            is_non_deliverable=False,
                            quotation_mode=definitions.QuotationMode.OUTRIGHT
                        )
                    )
                ]
            ),
        )
    ]
)
